title: Mapping-free retrieval/counter-authority falsifier EXTENDED to the never-measured withheld packet 39275520116
why_this_cycle: The accepted mapping-free recall falsifier (instrument sha256 58a2e77a...) has been executed on three of the four claim-relevant recorded packets: 38839347028 + rebuilt-39027045675 (accepted run 39225862749: 36 gates, 6 failed, PRODUCT_FALSIFIED) and the V3 packet-of-record 39319405429 (accepted runs 39522789347 and 39693031072: 18 gates, 4 failed, PRODUCT_FALSIFIED). Packet 39275520116 — the intermediate packet the v61 direction holds as BUILT_NOT_SERVED WITHHELD_PENDING_SERVE, and a member of the accepted 14-bundle counter-probe population (results/evaluation/counter_probe_repair_verification/39687372110.json) — has NEVER been scored by this instrument (verified: no prior mapping_free_recall_falsifier record carries 39275520116 in packets_measured). This is the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority measurement that can still falsify the product on recorded bytes, reusing the accepted instrument verbatim. No obsolete universal-174k benchmark is run.
hypothesis: On the exact recorded bytes of packet 39275520116, the shipped counter-authority surface fails the frozen mf::counter_authority_surface gates on at least one of the three served languages (de-kapitalverletzung, fr-bail-entretien, it-responsabilita-medica). A bounded alternative is equally accepted: if every mapping-free gate passes on this packet, the instrument returns PASS_NO_FALSIFICATION and the V3 zero-emission is narrowed to a packet-specific regression between 39275520116 and 39319405429. Either outcome is a first-class result.
discriminating_purpose: The accepted V3 falsification (run 39693031072) showed ZERO counter-authority rows issued on all three V3 languages. The accepted legacy run 39225862749 showed the older packets issued counter rows (n_issued 25 de / 15 fr on 38839347028) but failed the gate on empty-evidence defects. The open question this run answers: is the zero/near-zero counter-authority emission a STANDING property of the shipped stage across the two most recent packets (39275520116 and 39319405429), or did the emission collapse occur strictly BETWEEN them? This changes the product handoff: a standing failure implicates the shipped adversarial stage generally; a between-packets regression narrows the bounded cause to the V3 rebuild. This is retrieval/CA-surface measurement only; the accepted counter-emission attribution (cause classes c_HYDRATION and e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT) and the serve-verdict cross-check 39457963802 cover the LABEL stage and do not answer this question.
